name: EPIC 201475825
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 14, 10.0 solar radii and 0.83 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 201475825 (K2 campaign 14): PARAM radius (solar radii) 10.032178 (16th-84th percentiles 9.791425-10.34105), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

mass.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 201475825 (K2 campaign 14): PARAM mass (solar masses) 0.83471 (16th-84th percentiles 0.78301-0.900576), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

temperature.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 201475825: APOGEE DR17 effective temperature 4992.2036 +/- 50 K (the catalogue's final uncertainty)

distance.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 201475825 (K2 campaign 14): PARAM asteroseismic distance (pc) 3408.4375 (16th-84th percentiles 3352.109375-3471.523438), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

color.reason: PARAM fits an extinction A_V = 0.13 mag toward this star (Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, AV-M), and the color routes do not remove extinction; APOGEE measured its temperature

text.card: A red giant 3,408 parsecs away, 10 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 14, give 0.83 solar masses and 10.0 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,992 K at its surface.
